skill.trigger_description: Triggers when user mentions Rhino CHATGPT, rhino-cad-mcp, the Rhino bridge, operator.sh, exchange.sh, structured bridge requests, controller/operator/reviewer roles, or asks to recall/load/orient on the system
skill.role_selection: operator by default in local coding sessions; controller/reviewer/universal on explicit request

installer.uninstall_scope: managed symlink and managed CLAUDE.md block only
installer.conflict_protection: stops and reports if ~/.claude/skills/rhino-chatgpt-orientation is not a symlink

restart_note: A Claude Code session restart is required for the new skill to appear in the current session's skill list. The skill is immediately available to any new session opened after install.
limitations: The current running Claude Code session will not see the new skill in /skills until restarted.
The skill runs ./orient.sh which requires the canonical repository to be present and accessible at /Users/nes/bin/mcp/rhino-cad-mcp.
If the repository is unavailable, the skill instructs Claude to report the failure rather than reconstruct state from memory.
